scope: Review of test-only change to rejection/evaluation integration regression; reviewer changed no source.
conclusion: The old assertion selected the last event from a concurrently populated timeline. The replacement requires exactly one matching flow event newer than the POST pre-cursor, checks successful HTTP and doing status, unchanged run IDs, and wraps the real synchronous _flow_fix to prove it was not invoked. This removes an invalid global event-order assumption while strengthening the no-rework behavior check.
